concept: A short list of actions that rises from the bottom, with Cancel set apart, so the way out is always in the same place on a phone.

default_to_avoid.pattern: a dropdown menu opened from a three-dot button on a phone, used instead of an action sheet
default_to_avoid.kind: action sheet, bottom menu, share sheet
default_to_avoid.why_not: a desktop menu is a small target far from the thumb; it puts a destructive action next to the others

derivation.consequence: light falls from above, so every surface carries a rim brightest along its top edge and a soft shadow below that says where it floats, and a recess is the inverse, shaded under its top lip and lit on its bottom lip; a nested surface adds no second blur, because one sheet of glass is one layer
derivation.form: two level-3 panes at the bottom edge: the actions, and Cancel apart under them

derivation.consequence: one solid fill exists, the loud solid (white in dark, ink in light); a promoted action is the same solid glowing with its own light, and a pane uses one of them
derivation.form: the critical action alone takes the critical mark colour and sits last

derivation.consequence: every target is at least 44px in its smaller dimension or has a 44px hit area
derivation.form: every action row is a full 44px target at thumb reach

options: A grouped list with Cancel apart
B one list with Cancel inside
C a menu at the trigger
variants.picked: A grouped list with Cancel apart
variants.reason: A keeps the way out in one place and away from the critical action (P5). B puts Cancel next to Delete. C is a desktop menu far from the thumb.

scrim.why: the scrim dims the screen under the sheet

wrap.why: the two panes at the bottom edge, one measure wide, with the overlay margin

group.why: the pane holding the title and the actions

head.why: the title and its sentence, centred above the actions

title.why: a short title in secondary text naming what the actions apply to

description.why: the consequence of the critical action, in secondary text

list.why: the actions one under another, each separated by a hairline

action.why: one action per 44px row, the label centred

cancel.why: Cancel in its own pane under the actions, always in the same place

critical.why: the action that destroys something, in the critical mark colour

icon.why: an icon at the icon size before the label

cancelPane.why: the separate level-3 pane that holds Cancel, the same in every theme and on every scene

preview.why: drawn in place for documentation: open, not modal, full width of its parent

hover.why: a row lightens under the pointer at press pace

focus-visible.why: the focus ring inside the row, the same in every theme and on every scene

@media forced-colors: active.why: forced colours outline both panes, the same in every theme and on every scene

@fade.why: the scrim fades in, zero under reduced motion

@from-bottom.why: the panes rise from the bottom edge and settle

background-color.why: the row tint eases at press pace, the same in every theme and on every scene
